nodes.label: Common Challenge Categories
nodes.rationale: Unlimited practice, curated, no AI generation, never touches ELO (XP+streak+skill mastery only per the blueprint's ELO/XP split); every category maps 1:1 onto an existing REUSE-flagged workstation so no new UI work is required to launch them.

nodes.label: Workstation Compositions (§2)
nodes.rationale: Canonical mapping of UI modules (Code Editor, SQL Editor, Notebook Cell, Excel Grid, Diagram Canvas...) to composed Workstations (Code, SQL, Notebook, React/Frontend, API, Terminal...), each bound to a validator type and an artifact type.

nodes.label: Validator Contracts (§3)
nodes.rationale: Every validator is a pure function (submission, config) -> {passed, score(0-100), detail}; none write ELO/XP directly, that is the downstream ELO/XP Engine's job. Types: test_case_judge, ground_truth_compare, published_result_compare, live_render_probe, http_assertion, command_output_match, formula_result_check, kpi_compare, rubric_review, numeric_tolerance, register_match.

nodes.label: Challenge Payload Schema (FROZEN v1.0)
nodes.rationale: Single source-of-truth JSON contract (challengeType, workstation, validator, rewardRules, portfolioDecision, ...); the hard gate is owned by a first-class pipeline step, the Challenge Payload Validator, sitting between Challenge Engine and Workstation Router — missing/invalid payload/validator/rewardRules is rejected there and logged as an analytics event, never reaching the Workstation Router or frontend.

nodes.label: Difficulty Variants Framework (§5)
nodes.rationale: Worked Easy/Medium/Hard/Expert progressions across SQL Joins, React Component Build, DevOps Pipeline Fix, and Vulnerability Fix; each Challenge Template declares which tiers it actually supports, not every template needs all four.

nodes.label: Skill Dependency Graphs (40 roles)
nodes.rationale: Prerequisite chains (A -> B, A -> {B,C}) for all 40 IT roles across Software Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud/Platform/DevOps, Security, QA/Testing, Mobile/Emerging, and Business/Data-Adjacent families.

nodes.label: Scenario Packs
nodes.rationale: Industry- and role-family-tagged bundles (Amazon, PayFast, MedCore, CloudNine) chaining scenario -> challenge templates, so a Data Analyst never gets handed a role-family-mismatched pack like PayFast: Auth Hardening.

nodes.label: Industry Catalog & Applicability (§8)
nodes.rationale: 8 industries mapped to strong/loose applicability per role family; Embedded/IoT, Android/iOS, and most QA roles are treated as industry-light since their Domain Challenges vary mainly by narrative flavor, not deep industry business logic.

nodes.label: Portfolio Artifact Types (§9)
nodes.rationale: code/report/dashboard/design/diagram, each carrying Portfolio Decision provenance (auto-published at score X vs. manually published below threshold) as the recruiter-facing honesty mechanism.

nodes.label: Content Versioning Model (§10)
nodes.rationale: Rule of thumb across every content layer (Challenge Template, Workstation, Validator, Skill Graph, Scenario Pack, Dataset): version bumps affect only new starts; every in-progress student is pinned to the version snapshot recorded on their challengeInstanceId at creation, keeping grading deterministic as content evolves underneath it.

nodes.label: Analytics / Telemetry (§11)
nodes.rationale: Ops-only metrics (completion time, pass rate, most-failed validator, hint usage, abandonment rate, AI feedback frequency, Challenge Payload Validator rejection rate) written to challenge_analytics_events to catch miscalibrated content and pipeline regressions early.

nodes.label: Dataset Versioning (§12)
nodes.rationale: Worked 'Amazon' dataset lineage (v1->v2 adds dedup-testing data quality issue, v3 adds a new returns table): dataset bug fixes ship as a new version rather than mutating in place, since mutating a dataset a student is actively querying would silently invalidate their in-flight ground_truth_compare/kpi_compare expectations.

nodes.label: Recruiter Skill Evidence
nodes.rationale: Structured metadata on every portfolio artifact (skill, status, score, verification, difficulty, industry, scenario, skills demonstrated); Verification=Self-Selected keeps the below-threshold publish path honest rather than presenting it as equivalent to a verified pass.

nodes.label: Career Family Extension Point (§14)
nodes.rationale: careerFamily is reserved and hardcoded to 'IT' for all current work so that a future family (ECE, Mechanical, Civil, MBA, Healthcare...) becomes a new branch under an existing root instead of a schema migration across every existing challenge payload, skill graph, and portfolio record.
